readmeCommands: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed && php artisan db:seed && php artisan ninja:create-test-data
notes: README's 'Quick Hosting Setup' block literally says 'composer i -o --no-dev'; its 'Developer environment' section (README.md:144-158) says developers should use 'composer i -o', which is what readmeCommands records. The git clone line (pinned to tag v5.11.53, older than VERSION.txt 5.13.49) is omitted. The sample-data command is optional (README.md:79) and the alternative to the /setup wizard; either path creates the schema. .env.example already contains a fixed APP_KEY, so key:generate is not required up front (the wizard regenerates it; CI runs it). Compiled assets are committed (public/build, Flutter main.dart.js), so no npm build is required; package.json (Vite/Tailwind) and playwright are only for rebuilding assets / e2e tests. CI (phpunit.yml) differs from local: cp .env.ci .env, composer install, key:generate, config:clear, ninja:post-update, optimize, migrate, db:seed, against MariaDB 10.6 + Redis with redis cache/queue/session; .env.example uses file/sync drivers so Redis is not needed locally. PHP floor 8.2 (composer.json require and config.platform, CI matrix 8.2-8.5). The official developer guide and self-host guide are external (invoiceninja.github.io, not read).
